# Findable
> Local AI visibility for North London plumbers. We fix Google Business Profiles and help trades show up in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok.

Site: https://findable.london/
Audience: plumbers in North London: Finchley, Barnet, Muswell Hill, Hendon, Enfield, Haringey (starting with N2, N3, N12, EN4, EN5, NW7)

## What we offer
- Free 2-minute self-check on this site (no login)
- Free full audit (map searches + AI assistants)
- Profile Fix-Up: £129 one-off (also the setup fee for the monthly plans) — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/14A5kw1Hh7mtazC4xF1Jm00
- Findable Essentials (visibility): start with £129 setup, then £59/month (first month free). Google posts, review replies, hours and Q&A, monthly map and AI-assistant recheck — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/7sYbIUdpZbCJazC2px1Jm01
- Findable Pro (visibility + admin automations): start with £129 setup, then £99/month (first month free). Everything in Essentials plus missed-call text-back, appointment confirmations and reminders (reply YES, or R to reschedule) and review requests after every job (no incentives) — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/8x23co71BbCJ37a8NV1Jm02
- Founding pilot (first 5 North London businesses): Profile Fix-Up free plus the first month on Findable Pro free, in exchange for a 5-minute feedback form and case-study permission — apply: https://findable.london/?offer=pilot#audit
- A free audit is the recommended first step.

## How it works
1. Free audit of Google profile, local map searches and AI answers
2. Fix-up with customer approval on every change
3. Monthly posts, review replies and rechecks; on Pro, missed-call text-back, reminders and review requests

## Important facts
- We never ask for Google passwords; customers add us as a Manager
- No fake reviews, no ranking guarantees
- Rolling monthly plans, no minimum term, cancel any time by emailing hello@findable.london
- Not a lead site: no lead fees, credits or shortlist charges; customers find the business on Google and call it directly
- Monthly plans: pay the £129 setup at checkout; the first monthly payment is 30 days later
- The Google Business Profile, photos and reviews always belong to the business; Findable is only a Manager and removes itself on cancellation

## Who's behind it
- Founded by Nick Cresner, a Finchley local who spent nine years mapping Britain's roads at Navteq and HERE, then worked as a web developer, on a maintenance team and as a property manager.

## Contact
Request a free audit via the form at https://findable.london/#audit (submissions are emailed to us; we reply within 2 working days), or email hello@findable.london
